name: Price drop card
oneLiner: a glass pricing card turns in 3D, the old price is struck through, the big price counts down to the new one and slams, a Save pill stamps onto the corner and the features tick in one by one
say: when the speaker reveals the price or the deal ('it used to be 49, now it's 19'): the strike lands on the old price, the count stops on the new one, the pill stamps on 'save'
